welcome.title: Welcome to LUMA
welcome.description: A quick tour of the main screens. You can skip it at any time, and take it again later from Settings.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: How much money you have left this cycle, and why.

current-cycle.title: This cycle
current-cycle.description: The payments coming up and the ones already overdue. This is where you confirm the real amounts of what you spent.

incomes.title: Incomes
incomes.description: What comes in each cycle: your paycheck and any other recurring income.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.description: Your fixed and variable expenses, with their category and due date.

savings.title: Savings
savings.description: Your savings goals and how much you've saved toward each one.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your account, your cycle type, the language, and the appearance. This tour also lives here, in case you want to repeat it.

closing.title: All set
closing.description: That's it. You can start using LUMA now.

dashboard.noSummaryYet: This is where the summary of your current cycle will live.

noCycle.title: You don't have an open cycle yet
noCycle.description: A cycle is the two-week or month period you're budgeting. Once you open it, your incomes, expenses, and goals come in as line items and your balance shows up.

hero.estimateNoticeOne: One expense still doesn't have a confirmed amount, so this figure is an estimate.
hero.estimateNoticeMany: {{count}} expenses still don't have a confirmed amount, so this figure is an estimate.
hero.deficitDetail: Your expenses and savings add up to more than what comes in this cycle. Below is where the difference could come from.
hero.balancedDetail: What comes in is just enough for what you planned. No room to spare, but nothing missing either.
hero.surplusWithSavingsDetail: Your savings for this cycle are already accounted for: this is what's left over after setting it aside.
hero.surplusNoSavingsDetail: This is your margin for the cycle. If you want, part of it could go to a savings goal.

composition.title: How it's split
composition.subtitle: Out of {{income}} coming in this cycle.
composition.savingsRate: You're setting aside {{percent}}% of what comes in.

cycleActions.confirmWithPending: Closing it will lock its {{total}} line items as a record that can no longer change. {{pending}} are still unconfirmed: they'll stay that way for good, and the closed cycle is what later explains your history.
cycleActions.confirmAllSettled: Closing it will lock its {{total}} line items as a record that can no longer change. Everything is confirmed, so you won't lose anything.

advice.title: Where it could come from
advice.subtitle: You're short {{amount}}. Here's what can be moved, from cheapest to move to most.
advice.noOptions: We couldn't find anything that can be moved without touching your critical expenses. You'd need to adjust an income or check whether some critical expense really is one.
advice.shortfall: Even moving all of this ({{covered}}) isn't enough to cover what's missing. It gets you closer, not to closing the cycle.
advice.savingNote: If you don't set it aside this cycle, the goal picks it back up in the next one.
advice.expenseNote: Removing it from this cycle doesn't delete the expense or deactivate it.

trend.title: Compared with the last cycle
trend.emptyDescription: Once you close your first cycle, you'll be able to see here whether you're doing better or worse than last time.
trend.previousOutflow: The cycle that started on {{date}} came out to {{amount}}.
trend.same: You're spending about the same as last cycle.
trend.up: You're spending {{amount}} more than last cycle.
trend.down: You're spending {{amount}} less than last cycle.

upcoming.title: What's next
upcoming.emptyDescription: There's nothing left to pay this cycle.

insights.title: Financial insights
insights.deficitCause: "{{category}}" is what went up the most this cycle: from {{previous}} to {{current}} (+{{increase}}).
insights.deficitCauseNote: It's not the only possible reason for the deficit, but it's the one that changed the most compared with the last cycle.
insights.surplusIntro: You have {{amount}} left over this cycle.
insights.surplusSharesIntro: This is how far it would go, following the order of your goals:
insights.surplusNoGoals: You don't have any active goal to assign it to. Create one in Savings if you want to make use of it.

incomes.title: Incomes

deleteConfirm.description: It disappears from your lists and can't be recovered. Cycles that already had it are unaffected. If you just want it to stop counting, use "Stop counting it".

form.name: Name
form.nameHelp: How you recognize it: Paycheck, Commissions, Rental income
form.reviewNotice: Since the amount changes, each cycle will ask you to confirm what it was before treating it as final.
form.amountHelp: Up to two decimals, no signs or commas
form.expectedDayHelp: If you enter 31, in short months it falls on the last day
form.endDateHelp: Leave it empty if it has no end date
form.editNotice: Changes apply starting next cycle. The current cycle keeps what it already had.

toast.updated: Income "{{name}}" updated. It applies starting next cycle.
toast.deactivated: "{{name}}" stops counting in the following cycles.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.description: What goes out each cycle: what always costs the same and what changes.

empty.filteredDescription: Try removing one to see the rest.
empty.title: You haven't added any expense yet
empty.description: Start with the ones that never fail: rent, utilities, groceries. If you already have an open cycle, they'll show up there right away.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete "{{name}}"
deleteConfirm.description: It disappears from your lists and can't be recovered. Cycles that already had it are unaffected. If you just want it to stop counting, use "Stop counting it".

form.name: Name
form.categoryHelp: Optional, but it helps the analysis later on
form.variableNotice: Each cycle will ask you to confirm what it was before treating it as final. The amount you enter here is just an estimate.
form.amountHelp: Up to two decimals, no signs or commas
form.flexibility: How much it can be moved
form.criticalNotice: LUMA will never suggest delaying this payment, even if you run short of money this cycle.
form.dueDayHelp: If you enter 31, in short months it falls on the last day
form.endDateHelp: Leave it empty if it has no end date
form.editNotice: Changes apply starting next cycle. The current cycle keeps what it already had.

toast.updated: Expense "{{name}}" updated. It applies starting next cycle.

savings.title: Savings
savings.description: Your goals in priority order: how much you've saved and how much goes toward each cycle.

contributionMode.AUTO_BY_TARGET_DATE: Calculate it for me, based on the date

contributionModeHelp.AUTO_BY_TARGET_DATE: LUMA splits what's missing across the cycles left until your target date.
contributionModeHelp.FIXED_PER_CYCLE: You decide how much to set aside each cycle.
contributionModeHelp.MANUAL: It doesn't subtract from your budget. You log contributions whenever you make them.

empty.filteredDescription: Try another status to see the rest.
empty.title: You don't have any goals yet
empty.description: Start with an emergency fund. If the goal subtracts from your budget, its contribution enters your current cycle right away.

savings.priorityNotice: The order is the priority: when a cycle has money left over, it's shared out from top to bottom. Drag a card or use the arrows to change it.
savings.manualNotice: This goal doesn't subtract from your budget. It won't show up as a line item in your cycles: you log contributions whenever you make them.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete "{{name}}"
deleteConfirm.description: The goal disappears from your lists and stops subtracting from your cycles. What you already saved stays in the history, but the goal can't be recovered. If you just want to pause it for a while, use "Pause".

form.name: What it's for
form.target: How much you want to save
form.targetHelp: Up to two decimals, no signs or commas
form.targetDateHelp: Without a date there's no way to split what's missing across cycles.
form.perCycleHelp: It's set aside every cycle, even if the goal takes longer to reach.
form.editNotice: Changes apply starting next cycle. The current cycle keeps what it already had.

movement.amountHelpWithdrawal: As a positive number. Can't be more than what you've saved.
movement.amountHelpContribution: As a positive number, up to two decimals.
movement.notesHelpWithdrawal: Where it went and what for, so you remember later.

movements.emptyDescription: Contributions you confirm in your cycles and the ones you log yourself will show up here.
movements.fromCycle: Came in when the cycle was confirmed

noneToReview.title: There's nothing left to review
noneToReview.description: Every expense this cycle already has an amount. When you add a new variable one, it'll show up here.
